verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents several single actions that take effect across many resources. One credential rotation updates every Sprite, one org-level service connection reaches every Sprite, access can be granted by label, and a single command deploys across regions or scales horizontally. There is no documented general-purpose bulk operation, such as selecting or filtering many Machines, apps or volumes and acting on them in one batch. Missing for 10: a documented generic batch/bulk API or CLI operation across arbitrary sets of items, label- or filter-based bulk actions beyond access grants, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential.
Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it.
Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint
deploy to those regions with a single command
the `fly scale` command for quick horizontal and vertical scaling
